_comment: scheduling scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
This bench is plain planning and writing, so a single chat model is all you
need. Point at a local model (LM Studio / llama.cpp / Ollama) or any
snapshots let you /undo an edit to the plan; pathFence keeps writes inside
